claims.head: The Oilers want McDavid head to head with Kaprizov
claims.call: The Oilers’ L1 (Draisaitl, McDavid and Podkolzin) spends at least 55% of its 5-on-5 time against the Wild’s first line.
claims.body: At home, the Oilers keep sending McDavid’s line (Draisaitl, McDavid and Podkolzin) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Mike Babcock has been choosing strength on strength. Tonight the Wild’s first line is Ek, Kaprizov and Boldy.

notes.text: Marcus Foligno is on injured reserve and has missed the last 4 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Jared Spurgeon is out (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-four defenseman. Jonas Brodin has taken his spot beside Quinn Hughes.
Brock Faber is on injured reserve (skull surgery) and has not played this season. He is a top-pair defenseman. Jonas Brodin has taken his spot beside Quinn Hughes.
Tyler Pitlick was added to the roster on Oct 13 and has played beside Michael McCarron and Yakov Trenin.
Zach Hyman has not dressed for the last 6 games. He is a top-six forward.
Ryan Nugent-Hopkins is on injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward.
Matt Savoie is on long-term injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has not played this season. Leon Draisaitl has taken his spot beside Connor McDavid and Vasily Podkolzin.
Filip Hållander joined from PIT on Oct 7 and has played beside Jason Dickinson and Kasperi Kapanen.
Kasperi Kapanen has started playing on the power play: on the ice for 59% of the team’s power-play time in 7 games, up from 6% last season.
Ty Emberson is no longer killing penalties: 3% of the team’s shorthanded time in 5 games, down from 30% last season.

EDM.head: Leaning the Oilers’ way
EDM.body: Edmonton has home-ice advantage, has been out-chancing opponents lately and gets Hyman back. The Wild can still swing it if their power play gets going.

MIN.head: A slightly uphill night for the Wild
MIN.body: Edmonton has home-ice advantage, has been out-chancing opponents lately and gets Hyman back. The Wild’s best way to tip it is a power play that gets going.

items.text: The Wild are newly without Jared Spurgeon, have been without Marcus Foligno since Oct 8, and have had to make do without Filip Gustavsson and Brock Faber all season. Jesper Wallstedt is expected to start.

The Oilers are newly without Frederik Andersen, have been without Zach Hyman since Sep 29, and have had to make do without Ryan Nugent-Hopkins and Matt Savoie all season. Devon Levi is expected to start.
Matt Boldy has seven goals in eight games against Edmonton since 2023-24.
Quinn Hughes has a point in every game this season.
